objective: Screen whether a bounded recurrent-only FFN residual injected after Gemma's frozen MLP adds a structurally causal path beyond the attention-side addressed/global RWKV mixture.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: The trainable attention-side MoE strongly separated correct from zero recurrence (+0.882820 mean CE) and narrowly separated donor (+0.002533), but failed layer-permuted specificity (-0.000107).
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Keep the finite-gradient addressed/global MoE and add a query-gated recurrent FFN residual after the frozen MLP. Do not reuse the backward-unstable address-bound writer.

architecture.attention_gate: three-way query-conditioned softmax over normalized query, addressed read, and global read
architecture.outer_ffn: identity-initialized recurrent down projection, query-conditioned sigmoid gate, SiLU, and delta-o-initialized up projection
architecture.outer_ffn_placement: forward hook on each Gemma decoder layer's post_feedforward_layernorm output, after the frozen MLP and before the decoder residual addition
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero addressed and global recurrence makes both the attention correction and outer FFN residual exactly zero, returning the projected-only carrier bit-exactly.
architecture.frozen_base_boundary: Base attention and Gemma MLP weights remain frozen; only DeltaMem/RWKV adapter parameters may be trained by a later protocol.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked supervised causal training run on the remaining source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and do not open that endpoint.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, the unused strength holdout, or native generation.
